notes: Minimal independent group test: fresh reset, marquee three nodes, Ctrl+G, click blank, then drag one member. Do not confuse a retained multiselection with a persistent group.
A second fresh scenario duplicates the original group, moves the copy, ungroups only the copy, clears selection, then drags an original member before any snapshot restore.
Color test changes a middle node green, then selects the blue Proposal node. Inspect whether the properties panel actually indicates the current color.
Atomic deletion supplement explicitly selects the full original graph with a correctly bounded marquee; Undo is followed immediately by editing without snapshot restore.
Judge the exact assertions, and do not infer results only from button presence.
The full JSON was read from the visible export dialog and fed byte-for-byte to import, with the attached parse and SHA256 receipt. It is not evaluator-created replacement data.
Snapshot tests concern the actual existing document: a failed label-edit feature is evaluated separately, and Restore is not expected to invent a label that was never saved.
The panel was visibly placed behind nodes and locked before Save; later restored/imported panel drag and foreground drag are shown.

LATE-* is an additional fresh browser session for the SAME immutable candidate. It imports its earlier own export, saves a snapshot, and uses actual visible panel bounds for lock drags before and after restore.

The second late scenario records the immediate lock feedback before deselection, then drags the locked panel. It also clicks the exact observed zoom percentage DOM element and retries double-click; the control inventory is included.
